text:
marina: heads-up: scheduling a config-only push tonight 02:00 UTC. target: prod global (gradual ramp). changing soft_limit -> 0.85, tenant_ratecap default 120r/s -> 90r/s, default batch_size 16 -> 8, request_timeout_ms 12000 -> 9000. will pin routing policy to 'prefer-low-latency' for this rollout. canary in us-central1 for 20m first.

liam: copying — where's the rollback threshold?

marina: rollback if 99p latency increases >20% vs baseline OR 5xx rate >0.5% for 10m. also revert if error bursts correlate with kvcache eviction spikes.

kai: adding perf checks: track token/sec, inflight queues, per-tenant throttles. will add dashboard panel and alert.

deploy-bot: [deploy scheduled] config-only::soft_limit=0.85,tenant_ratecap=90,batch_size=8,timeout=9000 -> canary(us-central1) at 1736544010

sre-jen: quick note — we should preserve a warmup window on the canary hosts: set ttl_warmup_ms to 10000 for 5 minutes after rollout to avoid cold-kv spikes.

marina: good catch, add ttl_warmup_ms=10000 for canary.

liam: pinging marketplace customers that have pinned versions? any tenant pins affected by routing policy change?

marina: routing policy pin only affects route weighting, not model versions. customers with explicit tenant_ratecap overrides are unaffected. I'll post release notes.

kai: suggested preflight CLI for config diff:

```
redwoodctl config diff --env prod --key soft_limit
redwoodctl config apply --env prod --scope canary --file canary-softlimit.json
```

marina: applied canary payload to staging earlier, perf looked fine. small tail latency up ~6%.

deploy-bot: [canary applied] canary(us-central1) config v=cfg-2026-04-02-002 at 1736543250

sre-jen: monitoring panels ready: 99p-latency, p95, 5xx-rate, kvcache-evicts/min, batch-size-utilization. alert thresholds: 99p > baseline*1.2, 5xx > 0.005.

liam: ops-lead — can we hold traffic steering for 30m after canary? want a slow ramp.

ops-lead: yes. ramp plan: 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% over 3 hours with manual gates at each step. manual sign-off required.

marina: docs snippet for release notes (will post to #announcements after prod):

```
Config-only update (no model/runtime changes):
- soft_limit: 0.90 -> 0.85 (more conservative shaping under bursty load)
- tenant_ratecap: default 120r/s -> 90r/s
- default_batch_size: 16 -> 8 (reduce tail latency under heterogeneous seq lengths)
- request_timeout_ms: 12000 -> 9000
- routing policy pinned to prefer-low-latency during rollout
```

marina: also note: TTL warmup on canary nodes to 10000ms for 5m.

kai: if we see elevated queuing with smaller batches, consider quick toggle: batch_size -> 12 for specific high-throughput routes. keep that as fast rollback knob.

sre-jen: adding a synthetic probe hitting heavy routes every 15s to catch regressions.

deploy-bot: [canary metrics snapshot] p95: 210ms (baseline 190ms), p99: 780ms (baseline 740ms), 5xx: 0.02% — monitoring. at 1736543470

liam: :eyes: small bump but within thresholds. continue to ramp?

ops-lead: hold at canary for full 20m, then move to 5% global if stable.

marina: approved by me and liam for staged ramp after canary window. I'll run the rollout and tag with cfg-2026-04-02-002.

deploy-bot: [rollout] staged apply -> 5% at 1736543610

sre-jen: alert: kvcache evictions spiked on one host in eu-west1 at 1736543665, correlated with tenant X traffic. p99 there jumped to 1.4s. investigating.

marina: pause ramp. ops-lead please hold further percentage increases.

ops-lead: paused. initiating quick rollback for eu-west1 route weight.

kai: clue: tenant X uses long sequences, smaller batch size hurts their throughput and triggers eviction; suggest per-route override to batch_size=16 for routes matching tenant X.

marina: creating hotfix config to set per-route override for tenant X -> batch_size 16 and tenant_ratecap 150 for their override.

deploy-bot: [hotfix apply] per-route override for tenant X pushed to prod (eu-west1) at 1736543730

sre-jen: after hotfix, eu-west1 p99 dropped to 750ms, 5xx back to baseline. Good.

marina: consensus: do not full rollback. keep global config but add the per-route exception for tenant X. ops-lead, confirm ramp resume plan?

ops-lead: resume: continue from 5% -> 20% after 10m hold, then proceed with manual checks.

liam: mark release notes with: "added per-route override for tenant X to mitigate high-seq workload". Also note monitoring playbook steps and rollback criteria.

marina: tagging the release: cfg-2026-04-02-002 (config-only). will send announcement after 100% and 30m healthy.

deploy-bot: [rollout] resumed -> 20% at 1736543790

sre-jen: all panels green at 20% for 8m. no alerts.

marina: moving to 50% in 15m if still nominal.

liam: :thumbsup: great run. add note to runbook: keep batch-size per-route override as first recovery knob for heterogeneous seq workloads.

marina: thanks team. I'll post the post-rollout summary once at 100% and 30m healthy.
